requirements.acceptance: When any player attacks, every connected client (including the attacker) sees the same R15 punch animation play on the attacker's character via its Animator, regardless of hit or miss outcome, sourced from the verified Marketplace clip.

requirements.description: Only when the server confirms a hit, it broadcasts HitConfirmed with the contact point Vector3 to all clients for VFX/SFX spawning; misses never fire HitConfirmed, and this payload is never used as the basis for scoring.
requirements.acceptance: HitConfirmed fires exactly once per confirmed hit with a contact position at the dummy's hit reference point; it never fires on a miss; no client-side code uses this event to update the hit counter.

requirements.description: At the single point where CombatService confirms a hit on the server, it invokes the shared per-player Hit Counter Service exactly once to register that hit for the attacking player's UserId, forming the sole call site that can increase a player's count.
requirements.acceptance: Tracing CombatService's server code shows exactly one call site, inside the confirmed-hit branch, that registers a hit for the attacking player's UserId; no other code path in CombatService can trigger this registration, and misses never reach it.

requirements.description: Import and statically inspect the 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' Marketplace model (86089736228455): document its ParticleEmitters/Beams/Attachments/effect parts, confirm it contains no unrelated scripts or gameplay logic, and verify it is a self-contained, clonable visual effect suitable for spawning at a hit position.
requirements.sourceQuote: Use a bright, stylized practice arena with cartoonish impact VFX and SFX.
requirements.acceptance: Asset 86089736228455 is resolved and its hierarchy inspected; the effect-producing parts (ParticleEmitters/Beams/etc.) and their emit/lifetime behavior are identified; no embedded script controls gameplay, health, or combat; the model is confirmed usable as a template to clone at a runtime position.

requirements.description: Resolve and inspect the 'Punch Impact 1' Marketplace sound asset (132504023010884) to confirm it is a valid, loadable Sound with a usable SoundId before it is referenced by the client effects script.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Asset 132504023010884 resolves to a playable Sound/SoundId; native loading is verified to complete without error prior to being wired into HitConfirmed playback; provenance of the asset id is preserved unchanged.

requirements.description: A client-only LocalScript subscribes to the existing ReplicatedStorage HitConfirmed RemoteEvent and treats it as the sole trigger for impact VFX/SFX; it never fabricates or predicts a hit locally and never feeds this event into any scoring logic.
requirements.acceptance: A LocalScript under StarterPlayerScripts connects to HitConfirmed.OnClientEvent exactly once for its lifecycle; effect spawning code only runs inside that handler, receiving the server-provided {position: Vector3} payload, and no client code writes to the hit counter or infers hits independently.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, spawn a clone of the inspected cartoonish VFX effect positioned at the payload's contact point on every client so the impact reads as an exaggerated, stylized burst matching the arena's tone.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit produces a clone of the inspected VFX model positioned at the HitConfirmed payload position on every connected client; its particle/beam effects visibly emit; the effect does not appear on misses since HitConfirmed is never sent for a miss.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, play the verified 'Punch Impact 1' sound at (or attached near) the reported contact point on every client, synchronized with the VFX burst.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit plays a Sound using the verified SoundId, audibly positioned at the contact point for every connected client; the sound does not play on misses; native playback is verified before acceptance.

requirements.description: Transient VFX clones and one-shot Sound instances spawned per hit are automatically destroyed shortly after their effect/audio duration completes, so repeated hits across a multiplayer session never accumulate leftover instances under the namespace.
requirements.acceptance: Every spawned VFX clone and Sound instance is removed (e.g. via Debris:AddItem or a scheduled Destroy) within a bounded time after playing; triggering many hits in sequence, including from multiple players, leaves no orphaned effect or sound instances lingering in the scene.

requirements.description: Implement a server-side HitCounterService module that keeps a table indexed by Player.UserId tracking each player's confirmed hit count. The count is incremented only by CombatService's single hit-confirmation call site, persists across that player's respawns within the current server session, is cleared when the player leaves, and is never written to DataStore.
requirements.sourceQuote: The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: A ModuleScript exposes functions to register a hit for a Player and to read a Player's current count, backed by a table keyed by UserId; simulating a hit-register call followed by a simulated respawn (new Character, same UserId) shows the count unchanged; simulating PlayerRemoving clears that UserId's entry; no DataStore call exists anywhere in the module.

requirements.description: The server fires the existing CounterUpdated RemoteEvent to the owning client only: once whenever HitCounterService registers a hit for that player, and again whenever that player's CharacterAdded fires, so the HUD can resynchronize its displayed count after every respawn.
requirements.acceptance: Registering a hit for a player results in exactly one CounterUpdated FireClient call to that player's client carrying {count:number} equal to the new total; a subsequent CharacterAdded for that same player fires CounterUpdated again to that same client with the current stored count; other players never receive another player's CounterUpdated event.

requirements.description: No UI control, RemoteEvent, keybind or admin command exists anywhere in the HUD or counter service that can reset, decrement or otherwise clear a player's hit count mid-session; the only ways the count changes are hit registration and full clearing on PlayerRemoving.
requirements.sourceQuote: No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: Inspecting the HUD client script and HitCounterService/broadcast server scripts shows no exposed reset function, RemoteEvent, GUI button or input binding capable of lowering or clearing a live player's count; the only mutation paths are the single hit-registration call and the PlayerRemoving cleanup.

requirements.description: Create a persistent client HUD (ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn=false semantics, controlled from StarterPlayerScripts) showing a rounded top-corner panel with a bold numeral for the current hit count, always visible during play and unobtrusive elsewhere on screen.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.acceptance: Asset 132504023010884 resolves to a playable Sound/SoundId; native loading is verified to complete without error prior to being wired into HitConfirmed playback; provenance of the asset id is preserved unchanged.

requirements.description: A client-only LocalScript subscribes to the existing ReplicatedStorage HitConfirmed RemoteEvent and treats it as the sole trigger for impact VFX/SFX; it never fabricates or predicts a hit locally and never feeds this event into any scoring logic.
requirements.acceptance: A LocalScript under StarterPlayerScripts connects to HitConfirmed.OnClientEvent exactly once for its lifecycle; effect spawning code only runs inside that handler, receiving the server-provided {position: Vector3} payload, and no client code writes to the hit counter or infers hits independently.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, spawn a clone of the inspected cartoonish VFX effect positioned at the payload's contact point on every client so the impact reads as an exaggerated, stylized burst matching the arena's tone.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit produces a clone of the inspected VFX model positioned at the HitConfirmed payload position on every connected client; its particle/beam effects visibly emit; the effect does not appear on misses since HitConfirmed is never sent for a miss.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, play the verified 'Punch Impact 1' sound at (or attached near) the reported contact point on every client, synchronized with the VFX burst.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit plays a Sound using the verified SoundId, audibly positioned at the contact point for every connected client; the sound does not play on misses; native playback is verified before acceptance.

requirements.description: Transient VFX clones and one-shot Sound instances spawned per hit are automatically destroyed shortly after their effect/audio duration completes, so repeated hits across a multiplayer session never accumulate leftover instances under the namespace.
requirements.acceptance: Every spawned VFX clone and Sound instance is removed (e.g. via Debris:AddItem or a scheduled Destroy) within a bounded time after playing; triggering many hits in sequence, including from multiple players, leaves no orphaned effect or sound instances lingering in the scene.

requirements.description: Implement a server-side HitCounterService module that keeps a table indexed by Player.UserId tracking each player's confirmed hit count. The count is incremented only by CombatService's single hit-confirmation call site, persists across that player's respawns within the current server session, is cleared when the player leaves, and is never written to DataStore.
requirements.sourceQuote: The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: A ModuleScript exposes functions to register a hit for a Player and to read a Player's current count, backed by a table keyed by UserId; simulating a hit-register call followed by a simulated respawn (new Character, same UserId) shows the count unchanged; simulating PlayerRemoving clears that UserId's entry; no DataStore call exists anywhere in the module.

requirements.description: The server fires the existing CounterUpdated RemoteEvent to the owning client only: once whenever HitCounterService registers a hit for that player, and again whenever that player's CharacterAdded fires, so the HUD can resynchronize its displayed count after every respawn.
requirements.acceptance: Registering a hit for a player results in exactly one CounterUpdated FireClient call to that player's client carrying {count:number} equal to the new total; a subsequent CharacterAdded for that same player fires CounterUpdated again to that same client with the current stored count; other players never receive another player's CounterUpdated event.

requirements.description: No UI control, RemoteEvent, keybind or admin command exists anywhere in the HUD or counter service that can reset, decrement or otherwise clear a player's hit count mid-session; the only ways the count changes are hit registration and full clearing on PlayerRemoving.
requirements.sourceQuote: No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: Inspecting the HUD client script and HitCounterService/broadcast server scripts shows no exposed reset function, RemoteEvent, GUI button or input binding capable of lowering or clearing a live player's count; the only mutation paths are the single hit-registration call and the PlayerRemoving cleanup.

requirements.description: Create a persistent client HUD (ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn=false semantics, controlled from StarterPlayerScripts) showing a rounded top-corner panel with a bold numeral for the current hit count, always visible during play and unobtrusive elsewhere on screen.
requirements.acceptance: A ScreenGui containing a rounded top-corner Frame with a TextLabel numeral exists in PlayerGui at runtime, persists across character respawn without duplicating itself (no duplicate ScreenGui or stale numeral left behind after a respawn), and remains visible throughout the play session without blocking other gameplay UI.

requirements.description: The client HUD subscribes to CounterUpdated on the owning client and updates its displayed numeral to match the received count every time the event fires, rebinding its CharacterAdded-driven state cleanly (disconnecting any prior connection first) so no duplicate or stale subscriptions accumulate across respawns.
requirements.acceptance: Firing CounterUpdated with an incremented count updates the visible numeral to that exact value within the same frame cycle; triggering multiple CharacterAdded events in sequence for the same client leaves exactly one active CounterUpdated connection and one correct numeral, with no leftover connections from prior characters.

requirements.description: Style the HUD panel to match the arena's bright cartoonish theme: rounded corners, a bold high-contrast numeral, and a small fist/glove icon beside the count, positioned in a top corner so it reads clearly against the sky-toned backdrop without cluttering the screen.
requirements.acceptance: The HUD Frame uses a UICorner for rounded edges, a bold/high-contrast font and color for the numeral against its background, and includes an ImageLabel icon (fist/glove) beside the numeral; the panel occupies a single top corner of the screen and does not overlap or obscure other HUD elements.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: Import the selected Marketplace Training Dummy asset (1245720733) into the arena, inspect its full hierarchy and its one embedded script, and ensure the resulting instance is anchored/stationary, has no health or damage-taking system, and never attacks back. requirements.description: Create the RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed RemoteEvents under ReplicatedStorage within this namespace, matching the shared contract payloads exactly (RequestAttack: no payload; PlayAttackAnimation: {attacker: Player}; HitConfirmed: {position: Vector3}).
requirements.acceptance: RemoteEvent instances named RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed exist under ReplicatedStorage/Forge_c7540d7b8984, and CombatService is the only server system that fires PlayAttackAnimation/HitConfirmed, using the exact payload shapes specified in the shared contract.

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.

requirements.acceptance: Tracing CombatService's server code shows exactly one call site, inside the confirmed-hit branch, that registers a hit for the attacking player's UserId; no other code path in CombatService can trigger this registration, and misses never reach it.

The count is incremented only by CombatService's single hit-confirmation call site, persists across that player's respawns within the current server session, is cleared when the player leaves, and is never written to DataStore.
requirements.sourceQuote: The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: A ModuleScript exposes functions to register a hit for a Player and to read a Player's current count, backed by a table keyed by UserId; simulating a hit-register call followed by a simulated respawn (new Character, same UserId) shows the count unchanged; simulating PlayerRemoving clears that UserId's entry; no DataStore call exists anywhere in the module.

requirements.description: The server fires the existing CounterUpdated RemoteEvent to the owning client only: once whenever HitCounterService registers a hit for that player, and again whenever that player's CharacterAdded fires, so the HUD can resynchronize its displayed count after every respawn.
requirements.acceptance: Registering a hit for a player results in exactly one CounterUpdated FireClient call to that player's client carrying {count:number} equal to the new total; a subsequent CharacterAdded for that same player fires CounterUpdated again to that same client with the current stored count; other players never receive another player's CounterUpdated event.

requirements.description: No UI control, RemoteEvent, keybind or admin command exists anywhere in the HUD or counter service that can reset, decrement or otherwise clear a player's hit count mid-session; the only ways the count changes are hit registration and full clearing on PlayerRemoving.
requirements.sourceQuote: No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: Inspecting the HUD client script and HitCounterService/broadcast server scripts shows no exposed reset function, RemoteEvent, GUI button or input binding capable of lowering or clearing a live player's count; the only mutation paths are the single hit-registration call and the PlayerRemoving cleanup.

requirements.description: Create a persistent client HUD (ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn=false semantics, controlled from StarterPlayerScripts) showing a rounded top-corner panel with a bold numeral for the current hit count, always visible during play and unobtrusive elsewhere on screen.
requirements.acceptance: A ScreenGui containing a rounded top-corner Frame with a TextLabel numeral exists in PlayerGui at runtime, persists across character respawn without duplicating itself (no duplicate ScreenGui or stale numeral left behind after a respawn), and remains visible throughout the play session without blocking other gameplay UI.

requirements.description: The client HUD subscribes to CounterUpdated on the owning client and updates its displayed numeral to match the received count every time the event fires, rebinding its CharacterAdded-driven state cleanly (disconnecting any prior connection first) so no duplicate or stale subscriptions accumulate across respawns.
requirements.acceptance: Firing CounterUpdated with an incremented count updates the visible numeral to that exact value within the same frame cycle; triggering multiple CharacterAdded events in sequence for the same client leaves exactly one active CounterUpdated connection and one correct numeral, with no leftover connections from prior characters.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: Create the RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed RemoteEvents under ReplicatedStorage within this namespace, matching the shared contract payloads exactly (RequestAttack: no payload; PlayAttackAnimation: {attacker: Player}; HitConfirmed: {position: Vector3}).

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.

I want a simple fighting game with fist fighting animations from the Marketplace, a practice dummy to test on, VFX and SFX when attacking, and a hit counter that goes up every time I hit the dummy.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.

requirements.description: Only when the server confirms a hit, it broadcasts HitConfirmed with the contact point Vector3 to all clients for VFX/SFX spawning; misses never fire HitConfirmed, and this payload is never used as the basis for scoring.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: Expose exactly one clearly named BasePart or Attachment on the dummy as the single canonical hit-detection reference point that CombatService will measure distance and facing against, per the shared contract for this experience. No other health, damage-taking, or retaliation logic may be attached to the dummy or this reference point.
requirements.acceptance: Exactly one BasePart or Attachment (e.g. named HitTarget) exists on the dummy at a consistent body location such as the torso, is reachable via a stable relative path under Workspace/Forge_c7540d7b8984/World, and inspection confirms no script attaches health, damage-taking, or attack-back behavior to the dummy or this point.

requirements.description: Inspect the Marketplace R15 Punching Animations asset (12061946559) hierarchy, its one embedded script, and confirm clip key 1/1/18/1 resolves to a playable R15 punch Animation usable by an Animator, verifying it is safe to integrate (no unrelated gameplay logic) before CombatService references it.

requirements.description: Create the RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed RemoteEvents under ReplicatedStorage within this namespace, matching the shared contract payloads exactly (RequestAttack: no payload; PlayAttackAnimation: {attacker: Player}; HitConfirmed: {position: Vector3}).
requirements.acceptance: RemoteEvent instances named RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed exist under ReplicatedStorage/Forge_c7540d7b8984, and CombatService is the only server system that fires PlayAttackAnimation/HitConfirmed, using the exact payload shapes specified in the shared contract.

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.
requirements.sourceQuote: I want a simple fighting game with fist fighting animations from the Marketplace
requirements.acceptance: When any player attacks, every connected client (including the attacker) sees the same R15 punch animation play on the attacker's character via its Animator, regardless of hit or miss outcome, sourced from the verified Marketplace clip.

requirements.description: Only when the server confirms a hit, it broadcasts HitConfirmed with the contact point Vector3 to all clients for VFX/SFX spawning; misses never fire HitConfirmed, and this payload is never used as the basis for scoring.
requirements.acceptance: HitConfirmed fires exactly once per confirmed hit with a contact position at the dummy's hit reference point; it never fires on a miss; no client-side code uses this event to update the hit counter.

requirements.description: At the single point where CombatService confirms a hit on the server, it invokes the shared per-player Hit Counter Service exactly once to register that hit for the attacking player's UserId, forming the sole call site that can increase a player's count.
requirements.acceptance: Tracing CombatService's server code shows exactly one call site, inside the confirmed-hit branch, that registers a hit for the attacking player's UserId; no other code path in CombatService can trigger this registration, and misses never reach it.

requirements.description: Import and statically inspect the 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' Marketplace model (86089736228455): document its ParticleEmitters/Beams/Attachments/effect parts, confirm it contains no unrelated scripts or gameplay logic, and verify it is a self-contained, clonable visual effect suitable for spawning at a hit position.
requirements.sourceQuote: Use a bright, stylized practice arena with cartoonish impact VFX and SFX.
requirements.acceptance: Asset 86089736228455 is resolved and its hierarchy inspected; the effect-producing parts (ParticleEmitters/Beams/etc.) and their emit/lifetime behavior are identified; no embedded script controls gameplay, health, or combat; the model is confirmed usable as a template to clone at a runtime position.

requirements.acceptance: Asset 132504023010884 resolves to a playable Sound/SoundId; native loading is verified to complete without error prior to being wired into HitConfirmed playback; provenance of the asset id is preserved unchanged.

requirements.description: A client-only LocalScript subscribes to the existing ReplicatedStorage HitConfirmed RemoteEvent and treats it as the sole trigger for impact VFX/SFX; it never fabricates or predicts a hit locally and never feeds this event into any scoring logic.
requirements.acceptance: A LocalScript under StarterPlayerScripts connects to HitConfirmed.OnClientEvent exactly once for its lifecycle; effect spawning code only runs inside that handler, receiving the server-provided {position: Vector3} payload, and no client code writes to the hit counter or infers hits independently.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, spawn a clone of the inspected cartoonish VFX effect positioned at the payload's contact point on every client so the impact reads as an exaggerated, stylized burst matching the arena's tone.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit produces a clone of the inspected VFX model positioned at the HitConfirmed payload position on every connected client; its particle/beam effects visibly emit; the effect does not appear on misses since HitConfirmed is never sent for a miss.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, play the verified 'Punch Impact 1' sound at (or attached near) the reported contact point on every client, synchronized with the VFX burst.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX

requirements.description: Transient VFX clones and one-shot Sound instances spawned per hit are automatically destroyed shortly after their effect/audio duration completes, so repeated hits across a multiplayer session never accumulate leftover instances under the namespace.
requirements.acceptance: Every spawned VFX clone and Sound instance is removed (e.g. via Debris:AddItem or a scheduled Destroy) within a bounded time after playing; triggering many hits in sequence, including from multiple players, leaves no orphaned effect or sound instances lingering in the scene.

requirements.description: Implement a server-side HitCounterService module that keeps a table indexed by Player.UserId tracking each player's confirmed hit count. The count is incremented only by CombatService's single hit-confirmation call site, persists across that player's respawns within the current server session, is cleared when the player leaves, and is never written to DataStore.
requirements.sourceQuote: The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: A ModuleScript exposes functions to register a hit for a Player and to read a Player's current count, backed by a table keyed by UserId; simulating a hit-register call followed by a simulated respawn (new Character, same UserId) shows the count unchanged; simulating PlayerRemoving clears that UserId's entry; no DataStore call exists anywhere in the module.

requirements.description: The server fires the existing CounterUpdated RemoteEvent to the owning client only: once whenever HitCounterService registers a hit for that player, and again whenever that player's CharacterAdded fires, so the HUD can resynchronize its displayed count after every respawn.
requirements.acceptance: Registering a hit for a player results in exactly one CounterUpdated FireClient call to that player's client carrying {count:number} equal to the new total; a subsequent CharacterAdded for that same player fires CounterUpdated again to that same client with the current stored count; other players never receive another player's CounterUpdated event.

requirements.description: No UI control, RemoteEvent, keybind or admin command exists anywhere in the HUD or counter service that can reset, decrement or otherwise clear a player's hit count mid-session; the only ways the count changes are hit registration and full clearing on PlayerRemoving.
requirements.sourceQuote: No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: Inspecting the HUD client script and HitCounterService/broadcast server scripts shows no exposed reset function, RemoteEvent, GUI button or input binding capable of lowering or clearing a live player's count; the only mutation paths are the single hit-registration call and the PlayerRemoving cleanup.

requirements.description: Create a persistent client HUD (ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn=false semantics, controlled from StarterPlayerScripts) showing a rounded top-corner panel with a bold numeral for the current hit count, always visible during play and unobtrusive elsewhere on screen.

playerExperience.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
playerExperience.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

requirements.description: Import the selected Marketplace Training Dummy asset (1245720733) into the arena, inspect its full hierarchy and its one embedded script, and ensure the resulting instance is anchored/stationary, has no health or damage-taking system, and never attacks back. Disable or remove any embedded logic that would deal damage, retaliate, or otherwise deviate from a passive target.

requirements.description: Place the imported dummy standing upright on the flat top of the arena's pedestal, oriented so it faces the direction the player faces when spawning, matching the bright stylized theme already established by the arena.
requirements.acceptance: The dummy model's pivot/feet rest flush on the pedestal's flat top surface with no floating gap or clipping into the pedestal geometry, and its forward facing matches the spawn point's forward direction so a spawning player sees the dummy squarely ahead.

requirements.description: Expose exactly one clearly named BasePart or Attachment on the dummy as the single canonical hit-detection reference point that CombatService will measure distance and facing against, per the shared contract for this experience. No other health, damage-taking, or retaliation logic may be attached to the dummy or this reference point.
requirements.acceptance: Exactly one BasePart or Attachment (e.g. named HitTarget) exists on the dummy at a consistent body location such as the torso, is reachable via a stable relative path under Workspace/Forge_c7540d7b8984/World, and inspection confirms no script attaches health, damage-taking, or attack-back behavior to the dummy or this point.

requirements.description: Inspect the Marketplace R15 Punching Animations asset (12061946559) hierarchy, its one embedded script, and confirm clip key 1/1/18/1 resolves to a playable R15 punch Animation usable by an Animator, verifying it is safe to integrate (no unrelated gameplay logic) before CombatService references it.

requirements.acceptance: Inspection confirms the asset's embedded script content and locates the Animation instance/asset id corresponding to clip key 1/1/18/1; the clip is verified to natively play on an R15 Animator before CombatService references it, and any embedded script content unrelated to animation playback is identified and excluded from runtime use.

requirements.description: Create the RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed RemoteEvents under ReplicatedStorage within this namespace, matching the shared contract payloads exactly (RequestAttack: no payload; PlayAttackAnimation: {attacker: Player}; HitConfirmed: {position: Vector3}).
requirements.acceptance: RemoteEvent instances named RequestAttack, PlayAttackAnimation and HitConfirmed exist under ReplicatedStorage/Forge_c7540d7b8984, and CombatService is the only server system that fires PlayAttackAnimation/HitConfirmed, using the exact payload shapes specified in the shared contract.

requirements.description: On RequestAttack, the server validates the requesting player's character is alive/present, enforces a server-held attack cooldown/rate limit independent of client timing, and silently ignores requests that fail these checks without granting an attack.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid-fire RequestAttack calls from one client are throttled server-side to at most one accepted attack per cooldown window; requests from a dead or missing character are rejected; no client-supplied timing or payload data is trusted for these checks.

requirements.description: On each validated attack, the server measures the attacking character's distance and facing to the dummy's exposed canonical hit reference point (BasePart/Attachment) and decides hit or miss using server-side geometry only, never trusting any client-reported result.
requirements.acceptance: Standing within the defined melee range and facing the dummy's hit reference point yields a confirmed hit; standing out of range or facing away yields a miss; the decision is computed entirely from server-side character and dummy positions, never from a client message.

requirements.description: On every validated attack request, hit or miss, the server broadcasts PlayAttackAnimation with the attacking player so all clients play the inspected R15 punch clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on that character's Animator, keeping every player's swing visually synchronized.
requirements.sourceQuote: I want a simple fighting game with fist fighting animations from the Marketplace
requirements.acceptance: When any player attacks, every connected client (including the attacker) sees the same R15 punch animation play on the attacker's character via its Animator, regardless of hit or miss outcome, sourced from the verified Marketplace clip.

requirements.description: Only when the server confirms a hit, it broadcasts HitConfirmed with the contact point Vector3 to all clients for VFX/SFX spawning; misses never fire HitConfirmed, and this payload is never used as the basis for scoring.
requirements.acceptance: HitConfirmed fires exactly once per confirmed hit with a contact position at the dummy's hit reference point; it never fires on a miss; no client-side code uses this event to update the hit counter.

requirements.description: At the single point where CombatService confirms a hit on the server, it invokes the shared per-player Hit Counter Service exactly once to register that hit for the attacking player's UserId, forming the sole call site that can increase a player's count.
requirements.acceptance: Tracing CombatService's server code shows exactly one call site, inside the confirmed-hit branch, that registers a hit for the attacking player's UserId; no other code path in CombatService can trigger this registration, and misses never reach it.

requirements.description: Import and statically inspect the 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' Marketplace model (86089736228455): document its ParticleEmitters/Beams/Attachments/effect parts, confirm it contains no unrelated scripts or gameplay logic, and verify it is a self-contained, clonable visual effect suitable for spawning at a hit position.
requirements.sourceQuote: Use a bright, stylized practice arena with cartoonish impact VFX and SFX.
requirements.acceptance: Asset 86089736228455 is resolved and its hierarchy inspected; the effect-producing parts (ParticleEmitters/Beams/etc.) and their emit/lifetime behavior are identified; no embedded script controls gameplay, health, or combat; the model is confirmed usable as a template to clone at a runtime position.

requirements.description: Resolve and inspect the 'Punch Impact 1' Marketplace sound asset (132504023010884) to confirm it is a valid, loadable Sound with a usable SoundId before it is referenced by the client effects script.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Asset 132504023010884 resolves to a playable Sound/SoundId; native loading is verified to complete without error prior to being wired into HitConfirmed playback; provenance of the asset id is preserved unchanged.

requirements.description: A client-only LocalScript subscribes to the existing ReplicatedStorage HitConfirmed RemoteEvent and treats it as the sole trigger for impact VFX/SFX; it never fabricates or predicts a hit locally and never feeds this event into any scoring logic.
requirements.acceptance: A LocalScript under StarterPlayerScripts connects to HitConfirmed.OnClientEvent exactly once for its lifecycle; effect spawning code only runs inside that handler, receiving the server-provided {position: Vector3} payload, and no client code writes to the hit counter or infers hits independently.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, spawn a clone of the inspected cartoonish VFX effect positioned at the payload's contact point on every client so the impact reads as an exaggerated, stylized burst matching the arena's tone.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit produces a clone of the inspected VFX model positioned at the HitConfirmed payload position on every connected client; its particle/beam effects visibly emit; the effect does not appear on misses since HitConfirmed is never sent for a miss.

requirements.description: On receiving HitConfirmed, play the verified 'Punch Impact 1' sound at (or attached near) the reported contact point on every client, synchronized with the VFX burst.
requirements.sourceQuote: cartoonish impact VFX and SFX
requirements.acceptance: Each confirmed hit plays a Sound using the verified SoundId, audibly positioned at the contact point for every connected client; the sound does not play on misses; native playback is verified before acceptance.

requirements.description: Transient VFX clones and one-shot Sound instances spawned per hit are automatically destroyed shortly after their effect/audio duration completes, so repeated hits across a multiplayer session never accumulate leftover instances under the namespace.
requirements.acceptance: Every spawned VFX clone and Sound instance is removed (e.g. via Debris:AddItem or a scheduled Destroy) within a bounded time after playing; triggering many hits in sequence, including from multiple players, leaves no orphaned effect or sound instances lingering in the scene.

requirements.description: Implement a server-side HitCounterService module that keeps a table indexed by Player.UserId tracking each player's confirmed hit count. The count is incremented only by CombatService's single hit-confirmation call site, persists across that player's respawns within the current server session, is cleared when the player leaves, and is never written to DataStore.
requirements.sourceQuote: The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: A ModuleScript exposes functions to register a hit for a Player and to read a Player's current count, backed by a table keyed by UserId; simulating a hit-register call followed by a simulated respawn (new Character, same UserId) shows the count unchanged; simulating PlayerRemoving clears that UserId's entry; no DataStore call exists anywhere in the module.

requirements.description: The server fires the existing CounterUpdated RemoteEvent to the owning client only: once whenever HitCounterService registers a hit for that player, and again whenever that player's CharacterAdded fires, so the HUD can resynchronize its displayed count after every respawn.
requirements.acceptance: Registering a hit for a player results in exactly one CounterUpdated FireClient call to that player's client carrying {count:number} equal to the new total; a subsequent CharacterAdded for that same player fires CounterUpdated again to that same client with the current stored count; other players never receive another player's CounterUpdated event.

requirements.description: No UI control, RemoteEvent, keybind or admin command exists anywhere in the HUD or counter service that can reset, decrement or otherwise clear a player's hit count mid-session; the only ways the count changes are hit registration and full clearing on PlayerRemoving.
requirements.sourceQuote: No reset button is needed.
requirements.acceptance: Inspecting the HUD client script and HitCounterService/broadcast server scripts shows no exposed reset function, RemoteEvent, GUI button or input binding capable of lowering or clearing a live player's count; the only mutation paths are the single hit-registration call and the PlayerRemoving cleanup.

requirements.description: Create a persistent client HUD (ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn=false semantics, controlled from StarterPlayerScripts) showing a rounded top-corner panel with a bold numeral for the current hit count, always visible during play and unobtrusive elsewhere on screen.
requirements.acceptance: A ScreenGui containing a rounded top-corner Frame with a TextLabel numeral exists in PlayerGui at runtime, persists across character respawn without duplicating itself (no duplicate ScreenGui or stale numeral left behind after a respawn), and remains visible throughout the play session without blocking other gameplay UI.

requirements.description: The client HUD subscribes to CounterUpdated on the owning client and updates its displayed numeral to match the received count every time the event fires, rebinding its CharacterAdded-driven state cleanly (disconnecting any prior connection first) so no duplicate or stale subscriptions accumulate across respawns.
requirements.acceptance: Firing CounterUpdated with an incremented count updates the visible numeral to that exact value within the same frame cycle; triggering multiple CharacterAdded events in sequence for the same client leaves exactly one active CounterUpdated connection and one correct numeral, with no leftover connections from prior characters.

requirements.description: Style the HUD panel to match the arena's bright cartoonish theme: rounded corners, a bold high-contrast numeral, and a small fist/glove icon beside the count, positioned in a top corner so it reads clearly against the sky-toned backdrop without cluttering the screen.

inputContext.request:
I want a simple fighting game with fist fighting animations from the Marketplace, a practice dummy to test on, VFX and SFX when attacking, and a hit counter that goes up every time I hit the dummy.

Confirmed test decisions: Use a bright, stylized practice arena with cartoonish impact VFX and SFX. Use R15 characters and the punching animation clip in the selected Marketplace R15 Punching Animations pack by Auevi (model 12061946559). The practice dummy is stationary, indestructible, does not fight back and has no health or defeat condition. The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed. Choose sensible defaults for remaining cosmetic details. Keep Marketplace selections subject to asset inspection and native playback verification.
